import json
from fractions import Fraction

# Givens
money = {"gadwall": 11, "german_shepherd": 25, "wolf": 67}
ball_diameter = Fraction(22)
box = sorted([Fraction(235, 10), Fraction(287, 10), Fraction(213, 10)])

# Subquestions
combined_other = money["gadwall"] + money["german_shepherd"]
wolf_more_money = money["wolf"] > combined_other            # Rule5 antecedent
ball_fits_box = ball_diameter <= box[0]                     # sphere fits if diameter <= smallest side
movie_before_moon = False       # Rule1 antecedent: no movie information given (closed world)
abundance_of_food = False       # Rule3 antecedent: "struggles to find food"

# Wolf hugs the fish
neg_r1 = movie_before_moon      # Rule1 defeats Rule2 and Rule5 only if it fires
neg_r3 = abundance_of_food      # Rule3 defeats Rule2 and Rule5 only if it fires
hug_r2 = ball_fits_box and not neg_r1 and not neg_r3
hug_r5 = wolf_more_money
wolf_hugs_fish = (hug_r2 or hug_r5) and not neg_r1 and not neg_r3

# Walrus castle
zebra_dances_walrus = False     # Rule4 antecedent: not established (closed world)
rule4_fires = zebra_dances_walrus
rule6_fires = wolf_hugs_fish    # Rule6: walrus does not create castle if some animal hugs fish
castle_proved = rule4_fires     # Rule4 preferred over Rule6, but only if it fires

if castle_proved:
    final = "proved"
elif rule6_fires and not rule4_fires:
    final = "disproved"
else:
    final = "unknown"

evidence = {
    "combined_other_money": combined_other,
    "wolf_more_money": wolf_more_money,
    "ball_fits_box": ball_fits_box,
    "wolf_hugs_fish": wolf_hugs_fish,
    "rule4_fires": rule4_fires,
    "rule6_fires": rule6_fires,
}

print(json.dumps({"final_answer": final, "evidence": evidence}, separators=(",", ":")))
